Aparaitech Robotics Lab offers hands-on learning in Robotics, AI, Automation, and Embedded Systems.
Students explore technologies like Arduino, IoT, sensors, microcontrollers, and computer vision.
The program includes practical projects, mentor guidance, and portfolio-building experience.
Interested students can book a meeting slot

The Meeting Slot Booking System is a web-based application that allows users to book meetings online by entering their details, selecting a meeting type, date, and available time slot. The system uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend and Google Apps Script with Google Sheets for backend data storage. Each booking receives a unique Booking ID, and the booking details are automatically stored in the Google Sheet. The system can also send a confirmation email to the user after successful booking. This reduces manual work, prevents data-entry errors, and provides an organized way to manage meeting appointments.
